This is modeled by \( \frac{dM}{dt} = -\eta \cdot \text{performance loss} + \zeta \cdot \text{team cohesion} \). The system exhibits a phase transition at \( F_{\text{min}} \) and \( M_{\text{threshold}} \). Overuse beyond \( \tau_{\text{max}} \) games per week destabilizes the system.
